title: Cape Town, Western Cape — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Cape Town, Western Cape: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Cape Town is a city in Western Cape with a population of 4,005,000. The Mother City, famous for Table Mountain, stunning beaches, vibrant waterfront, and world-class wine regions. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 300 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
